_about: Candidate letter sounds. Listen at /tryout/ on the live site. A/B/C: ElevenLabs (Toota). G1/G2: Gemini TTS, free tier.

items.label: G1
items.style: Modern Standard Arabic (Fusha), not Egyptian dialect. A warm, gentle female phonics teacher for a 6-year-old says only this one letter sound, clearly and a little slowly: the consonant followed by a short a. Do not say the letter name, and say nothing else.
